whoItsFor: Developers and AI-agent builders who want to drive their logged-in Chrome browser from the command line or let an AI agent navigate, click, fill forms, and extract data from websites. The README also covers writing reusable site-specific adapters.
useCases: Run deterministic CLI commands for sites like Bilibili, Zhihu, Reddit, or HackerNews
Let an AI agent navigate, fill forms, and extract data via the logged-in browser
Write and verify reusable adapters that turn a new website into CLI commands

requirements.runtime: Node.js >= 20.18.1 (npm install); Chrome/Chromium with the Browser Bridge extension
